title: Personal Services Plan — Basis Hours of a Missed Visit for Short Bookings and Laundry Orders
content:
The hours owed under the Personal Services Plan for a late-cancelled or missed visit are worked from the visit's basis hours, which take account of how many hours the order booked and of the service booked.

## Rule

The basis hours of a missed visit are found by one of three methods: where the order booked fewer hours than the band hours, the basis is the booked hours; where the order was a laundry and linen order booking at least the band hours, the basis is the band hours multiplied by 0.5, since no load was started; otherwise the basis is the band hours.

The booked hours and the service are those on the missed order's booking; the band hours are the missed visit's band hours.

## Method table

| Booked hours compared with the band hours | Service booked | Basis hours |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer | Any | The booked hours |
| Equal or more | Laundry and linen | The band hours multiplied by 0.5 |
| Equal or more | Any other service | The band hours |

## Hypothetical cases (band hours of 1.0)

| Order | Basis hours |
|---|---|
| Extra housekeeping, 0.5 hour booked | 0.5 (booked hours, fewer than the band) |
| Laundry and linen, 0.25 hour booked | 0.25 (booked hours, fewer than the band) |
| Laundry and linen, 1.0 hour booked | 0.5 (1.0 multiplied by 0.5) |
| Laundry and linen, 2 hours booked | 0.5 |
| Companion visit, 2 hours booked | 1.0 (the band hours) |
